sources.entry: Photostockeditor - Intelligence Image Crop/Resize: Perfectly Tailored Social Media Images #free

summary.name: Photostockeditor Intelligence Crop/Resize
summary.one_liner: A web tool that uses AI to detect objects in an image and crop or resize it to the size requirements of many social media platforms.
use_cases: resize photos for Instagram feed or stories
prepare LinkedIn cover or profile images
create YouTube thumbnails at correct size
size app store and Play Store screenshots
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an online tool that uses AI to automatically recognize objects in an uploaded image and crop them to fit a chosen social media format. The user selects a target size from a long list covering Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Snapchat, YouTube, Pinterest, Twitch, WhatsApp, TikTok, Product Hunt, Behance, App Store, and Play Store. The page also links to stock image categories (nature, business, backgrounds, travel) for use after resizing. The page is marked as beta.
notable: AI object recognition that crops around detected objects
Large preset list of social media and app store image sizes
Links to stock photo categories for design work
caveats: Pricing is only implied as free by the directory listing (#free); the page itself does not state pricing
